name: Desktop and Mobile Apps with Web
summary: Take the web app you already built to the app stores and to the desktop — and know when wrapping it is not enough and it has to be native.
prerequisites: Requires an application of your own, in any of the four frameworks — Capacitor takes it as it is. React Native is the other path, and reuses the JavaScript you already write.
syllabus: Capacitor: the app you already built, in any framework, as a native project
Device features through the bridge, and a plugin of your own when it is missing
React Native and Expo: the native path, and what it buys over the wrapper
Desktop apps with Electron and Tauri
Final project: a published app in your portfolio
